messages:
maria_p: Quick sync — need to lock Q3 observability scope: dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown, error analytics. TL;DR: what is the true minimal GA we can ship that satisfies our enterprise asks?
jamal_e: +1 to narrow. Do we have customer asks that mandate traces at launch or can we start with error-only traces?
diego_cs: Two enterprise customers (paymentX, atlas-inc) called out per-route cost breakdown + link-to-trace for failed requests as must-have for procurement.
sophia_sre: We should avoid high sampling rates at GA. Propose error-triggered traces + 0.5% background sample for signals. Keeps storage/cost down.
elaine_data: For dashboards, recommend these widgets: per-customer token-cost, per-model p50/p95 latency, error rate by route, and a small anomalies panel for sudden cost deltas. We can drive these from the telemetry index.
maria_p: Proposed acceptance criteria (draft):
  1) Dashboards: token-cost by route + top-5 customers visible in UI;
  2) Traces: error-triggered traces (100%) + 0.5% background sampling;
  3) Cost: per-route breakdown with weekly baseline & alerting;
  4) Errors: grouped by stack/message with trace-id linkback.
Thoughts?
jamal_e: Tech constraints: capturing model_version and trace_id in spans requires a tiny runtime patch (attach metadata to span). Low risk but ~2 dev days + tests. Also need retention policy decisions for sampled traces.
anya_pm: From customers: please gate tracing for enterprise-only at GA. They don't want broad trace retention.
sophia_sre: Agreed — gate via routing policy + feature flag. For private/on-prem installs we can enable higher sampling by default.
ryan_prod: Quick config snippet for sampling flags (proto):
```json
{
  "trace_sampling": {
    "default": 0.005,
    "error_override": 1.0,
    "customers": ["paymentX", "atlas-inc"]
  }
}
```
diego_cs: +1 on gating. Also ask that dashboards expose a "what changed" timeline (e.g., model quantization / new kernel) so CS can pre-empt customer surprised reactions when perf shifts.
maria_p: Launch plan sketch: canary to 10% accounts -> 72h monitoring for errors/regressions -> widen. Rollout gate: cost delta < 5% per-token for 95% of accounts vs baseline. Is that actionable?
jamal_e: We can compute cost delta, but baseline variance is noisy. Recommend using rolling median and exclude top 1% outliers for decision.
elaine_data: I'll implement baseline windowing: 7d rolling median + cohort exclusion. I can own widgets for the rollout dashboard.
maria_p: OK — who's volunteering to own the runtime change (attach model_version + trace_id) and the tracing retention policy? Need ETA to plan sprints.
jamal_e: I'll take the runtime change. Estimate: 3 dev days + 1 day of integration tests and doc updates.
sophia_sre: I'll own feature-flag rollout config, alerting thresholds, and retention gating.
diego_cs: I'll coordinate customer validation with paymentX and atlas-inc for early access.
maria_p: Great. I'll update the PRD and the roadmap ticket with these owners and the acceptance criteria. If no objections by EOD tomorrow, I'll mark this as "scope agreed for GA" and spin up engineering tickets.
jamal_e: :thumbsup:
diego_cs: :rocket:
deploy-bot: canary rollout started for observability-gate to 10% (job 8472) — monitoring hooks attached.
thread_text_snippet: Locking Q3 observability scope: dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown, error analytics — acceptance criteria + owners agreed?
